tasks.title: Create ledger-backup.ts
tasks.description:
NEW src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts. Snapshot Write-Ahead Logging SQLite state via Online Backup API with repository metadata

REVIEW FAIL (code): Enrolled checkout identity — TR-005.
  WHERE: src/adapters/release/repository-evidence.ts:32-60
  EXPECTED: An unavailable enrolled checkout has head: null and evidence: [].
  ACTUAL: git rev-parse --verify HEAD^{commit} walks up from an empty enrolled directory and returns the parent repository's HEAD.
  FIX: Verify that Git's top-level path matches the canonical enrolled root before collecting evidence. Test an empty directory nested in a different repository.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T013, gate: gates/phase-04.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/adapters/release/repository-evidence.ts — In `readRepositoryEvidence`, resolve the enrolled directory and `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` with `realpathSync` from `node:fs`. Return `remote: null`, `head: null` and `evidence: []` if either lookup fails or the paths differ. Check this before reading `HEAD`.
FIX: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh — Extend `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts` with an enrolled empty directory inside a Git repo whose commit contains `specs/pilot/.gwrk/tasks.json`. Assert that backup metadata for the empty directory has `head: null` and `evidence: []`.
FIX: src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts — In `verifyLedgerAgainstBackup`, keep backup verification and the summary checks. Deep-compare `SELECT * FROM runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id` and `SELECT * FROM history ORDER BY id` against the same queries on the verified backup’s `gwrk.db`. Throw before reporting success if either result differs.
FIX: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh — Extend `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts` with separate cases that change `runs.exit_code` for run `42` from `0` to `1` and update `history.metadata` for row `1` after backup. Keep IDs and counts fixed. Assert that `verifyLedgerAgainstBackup` rejects each change.
FIX: src/cli.ts — Route Commander’s `missingMandatoryOptionValue` and `optionMissingArgument` errors through the stderr signal formatter in `src/utils/signal.ts`. Share that formatter with `withSignal` and set `process.exitCode = 2` so stderr can flush. In `src/commands/db.ts`, label `backup` as `generator` and `restore` as `mutator` in their descriptions.
FIX: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh — Extend `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts` to invoke `db backup` without `--out` and `db restore` with each required flag omitted in turn. Assert status `2` and one `[exit:2 | …]` signal on stderr. Assert that each command’s `--help` exits `0` and shows its classification.
FIX: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh — After acquiring `server.lock`, read `User` and `Group` from `systemctl show` for `$unit`. Run `db backup --out "$backup"` through `runuser -u "$service_user" -g "$service_group" --` with the exported state and runtime paths. Ensure that identity can traverse `$state` and write `$state/backups`. Keep the private `0700` backup mode.
FIX: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh — Run `tests/linux-runner/container-harness.mjs` against the candidate worktree, including uncommitted fixes. Extend `tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh` so the `systemctl` fixture reports `gwrk:gwrk`. After root-run rollback fails its ledger check, restore that attempt’s retained backup as `gwrk` into a clean state directory and compare the restored database with the backup snapshot.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Recovery backup ownership — TR-006 and backup contract steps 4 and 7.
  WHERE: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh:79-90 and src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts:140-148
  EXPECTED: The Linux service user can read the retained backup and run the documented restore.
  ACTUAL: The operator's Node process creates the backup directory with mode 0700. A root-run rollback leaves the backup unreadable to gwrk.
  FIX: Create the quiesced backup as the service identity in a directory it can traverse. Verify recovery from a backup produced by operator rollback using that identity.
